memberdef.name: retract_lens_script
memberdef.initializer:
= "if type(get_mode)~='function' or type(get_shooting)~='function' or " "type(get_tick_count)~='function' or type(sleep)~='function' then error('missing playback API') end
" "if get_shooting() then error('camera is shooting; lens retract rejected') end
" "local record=get_mode()
" "if type(record)~='boolean' then error('invalid camera mode') end
" "if record then
" " if type(switch_mode_usb)=='function' then switch_mode_usb(0)
" " elseif type(set_record)=='function' then set_record(false)
" " else error('missing playback transition API') end
" " local started=get_tick_count()
" " while get_mode() and bitand(get_tick_count()-started,2147483647)<5000 do sleep(50) end
" " if get_mode()~=false then error('cannot enter playback mode') end
" "end
" "return 'Playback confirmed; physical lens retraction not verified'
"

= "if type(call_event_proc)~='function' then error('native event procedures unavailable') end

" "if type(get_config_value)~='function' or get_config_value(1999)~=1 then error('Enable Lua native calls in CHDK menu, or use Save ROM crash log') end

briefdescription.para: Standalone USB PTP client for CHDK JPEG capture and normalized zoom.

detaileddescription.para:
One invocation owns one USB interface and PTP session. Standard PTP framing carries CHDK vendor commands; small Lua scripts execute on the camera, not on the host. USB access uses Linux usbfs directly (usbfs.h); no USB library is loaded. This standalone C client implements camera control directly over USB PTP.
A failed transaction is not retried: capture or lens movement may already have occurred. Fake-USB tests are not physical-camera validation.
